decisions.rationale: The contiguous span joins two separate condition mentions, 'hexosaminidase A deficiency' (a disease-level condition) and 'pseudodeficiency', so it is kept as one Composite Mention rather than split, since splitting would lose information.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate, Section 2 (Annotate contiguous text strings / Composite Mention)

decisions.rationale: 'Tay-Sachs disease' names one specific disease with no further categorization, so it is a Specific Disease mention.

'TSD' is the abbreviation defined in parentheses for Tay-Sachs disease. Abbreviation definitions are annotated as a separate synonymous mention, and the short form refers to the same specific disease.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate, Section 6 (Annotate all synonymous mentions) and Examples item 5

decisions.rationale: In 'TSD carriers', the abbreviation is a disease name used to modify the noun 'carriers', so it is annotated as a Modifier.

decisions.rationale: In 'TSD heterozygotes', the disease name modifies the noun 'heterozygotes' and does not refer to a disease itself, so it is a Modifier.
